text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hachimi~ Hachimi~ Ha~chi~mi~♪
Lick some Hachimi and you'll see~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My legs, my legs, my little legs~♪
Are gettin' soo faaast~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's any direct causal link
between honey and running fast, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Definitely!
The invincible Lord Teio's very existence is proof of that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, excuse me, server!
"Firm noodles, rich broth, extra oil," please~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... I would like
"soft noodles, normal broth, normal oil," please.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Nothing beats a Hachimi
after finishing practice~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Though I am a bit concerned about the calories—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A honey drink~?
Well, if Oguri wants to buy one, let's stop by.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Excuse me, shopkeep,
I'll take the "Extra-Honey Extra-Sweet Chomolungma Special," please.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What is this, some ramen joint?!
Like hell I'd have something like that!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪
Here is your 'Extra-Honey Extra-Sweet Chomolungma', sorry to keep you waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Like that's actually a thing?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Doing that full-force tsukkomi
really dried out my throat...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then drink my honey drink.
It'll fill you right up with energy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"It looks pretty rich and heavy, but...
Well, just one bite—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So sweeeeeet?!?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Extra Honey, Extra Sweet, Extra Chomolungma"...
That sounds rather intense, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know they had a menu item like that~!
Hey, hey, let's try ordering it next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible!
Doing such a thing all by myself—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even if we can't do it alone, we can together!
We've got this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just... one more time, understood?
